warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). CONFIRMS a full-length straight ridge along grid 2 (not a hip roof) — matches A-05's twin-gable plan exactly, and explains the CS steel columns on S-05 (they likely help support this long ridge beam at intermediate points, matching typical light-gauge steel roof-frame practice for a 9m ridge span).

Roof frame covers ONLY the main 3x4 grid (A to D, 1 to 3) — the C0 footings north of A / south of D remain UNEXPLAINED even after this sheet. Carried forward as an open question to S-07 (fascia/flashing detail, next sheet) and beyond.
Rafter/purlin spacing partly unspecified ('ระยะตามแบบ' for rafters) — recorded as printed, not guessed; purlin spacing IS numeric (1.00m max).
